title: Anthropic ships file-search tool for Claude, cutting agent setup from days to minutes
summary: A built-in retrieval tool lets Claude search company documents without a custom vector database, trimming a typical agent build by 3 days.

title: OpenAI cuts GPT-5 API prices by 40 percent for batch workloads
summary: Batch-tier pricing drops 40 percent, which changes the math for overnight document processing at small firms.

title: EU publishes final guidance on AI Act compliance for companies under 250 employees
summary: The guidance gives smaller firms a 12-month runway and a simplified self-assessment path for most internal automation use cases.

title: Google rolls out Gemini agents that file expense reports end to end in Workspace
summary: Workspace customers can hand full expense workflows to an agent, with human review kept for amounts over a set threshold.

title: Open-source Llama variant matches paid models on invoice extraction at 1/10th the cost
summary: A fine-tuned open model hits 98 percent field accuracy on a public invoice benchmark, at roughly a tenth of API list prices.
